main.description: A group's pool of galleries: the photos its members put in, with the camera details each carries, and their favourites and comments on them, held together as one space. The group is its authority and its space key is self. Each member's records stay in their own repo; the space says who may read them, which is the group's members. A favourite, a comment or a photo's camera details belong here rather than in the public repo for the same reason the photos do: in the public repo they would name a private gallery or photo to the whole network.
main.name: Group pool
